CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH sched AS (
  SELECT 
    s.term_code,
    s.subject_id,
    s.session_number,
    s.meet_place AS building_room,
    s.meet_start_time,
    s.meet_end_time,
    s.iap_date,
    -- parse start time to 24h
    CASE 
      WHEN length(trim(s.meet_start_time))>=6 THEN
        strftime(
          strptime(
            regexp_replace(upper(trim(s.meet_start_time)),'[^0-9APM:]',''),
            '%I%M%p'
          ),
          '%H:%M'
        )
      ELSE NULL
    END AS start_hm
  FROM course_schedule s
  WHERE s.building_room IS NOT NULL AND s.building_room <> ''
), sched2 AS (
  SELECT *,
         -- build sortable timestamp using date + time; fallback to noon if time missing
         COALESCE(
           strptime(iap_date||' '||COALESCE(start_hm,'12:00'), '%d-%b-%y %H:%M'),
           strptime(iap_date, '%d-%b-%y')
         ) AS start_ts,
         iap_date AS meeting_date
  FROM sched
), enriched AS (
  SELECT 
    s2.term_code,
    s2.subject_id,
    ct.subject_title AS course_name,
    b.building_name_long AS building_name,
    s2.meeting_date,
    s2.start_ts,
    r.area AS room_assignable_area,
    COALESCE(b.access_level_name::VARCHAR, CAST(b.access_level_code AS VARCHAR)) AS building_access_level,
    s2.building_room
  FROM sched2 s2
  LEFT JOIN course_titles ct USING(subject_id)
  LEFT JOIN rooms r USING(building_room)
  LEFT JOIN buildings b ON r.fclt_building_key = b.fclt_building_key
), ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY building_room, meeting_date ORDER BY start_ts, COALESCE(course_name, subject_id)) AS rn,
    LAG(COALESCE(course_name, subject_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY building_room, meeting_date ORDER BY start_ts, COALESCE(course_name, subject_id)) AS prev_course,
    LEAD(COALESCE(course_name, subject_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY building_room, meeting_date ORDER BY start_ts, COALESCE(course_name, subject_id)) AS next_course
  FROM enriched
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(course_name, subject_id) AS course_name,
  building_name,
  meeting_date AS start_date,
  prev_course AS course_before,
  next_course AS course_after,
  building_access_level AS access_level,
  room_assignable_area AS assignable_area
FROM ranked
ORDER BY start_ts NULLS LAST, course_name ASC
LIMIT 1000;
